newsitem.title: USA: Be Aerospace says Q3 new bookings rise.
newsitem.headline: Be Aerospace says Q3 new bookings rise.

text.p: BE Areospace Inc said it had new order bookings of $158 million in its fiscal 1997 third quarter, compared with $39 million in the year-ago period, a gain of 305 percent.
The company attributed the increased orders to a healthy areospace industry and strength in all its divisions.
It had a backlog at the end of the quarter of $530 million, compared with $369 million in the year-ago period and $480 million at the end of the second quarter.
The company reported third-quarter earnings Monday of $0.23 a share, compared with a loss of $0.87 a year ago.
